title: Make the KPI report fail closed, keep PII out, and attribute outbound clicks by page
why: kpi-report.mjs counted everything as real when the test-traffic predicate failed, printed lead names into committed output, grouped outbound clicks by partner only, and exited 0 when sections failed. Page attribution was first requested in directives/2026-09-22-cmo.md.
definition_of_done: kpi-report.mjs exits 2 on a predicate failure or failed section, prints leads by id only, shows outbound clicks by partner, page and placement with distinct visitors and paid clicks, and prints funnel view sources.
verify: node scripts/kpi-report.mjs --window 7 exits 0, ends with 'Report status: COMPLETE', and prints 'By page:' and no lead names.
